result.title: Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess
result.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted manuscript of the paper published at the 2026 IEEE Gaming, Entertainment, and Media Conference (GEM). Code: https://github.com/Prof-it/temporal-chess-model; weights: https://huggingface.co/holymolyyy/temporal-chess-model
result.summary: Behavioral cloning models in chess typically predict human moves from board states while ignoring temporal inputs such as the remaining clock. However, time pressure is a major determinant of human decision-making quality, and temporal state is a missing dimension of human behavioral modeling. This paper introduces a time-aware transformer that extends a Chessformer-style architecture with learned temporal conditioning tokens encoding player clock state, time control, and recent tempo, together with behavioral heads for thinking time and resignation. The model is trained on large-scale online chess data and evaluated against time-agnostic baselines and the state of the art. Results show that temporal conditioning yields modest overall accuracy improvements but substantially stronger gains under time pressure. Beyond move choice, it also produces more accurate thinking-time and resignation predictions. More importantly, the model better matches human move-quality degradation in critical time regimes, reducing the systematic over-strength observed in time-agnostic behavioral cloning models. These results suggest that temporal state is a previously underutilized but important signal for human behavioral cloning in chess.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出时间感知 transformer：在 Chessformer 风格架构中加入学习的时间条件 token（编码棋钟状态、时限与近期节奏）以及思考时间、认输两个行为预测头，在大规模在线棋局数据上训练，并与忽略时间的基线及 SOTA 比较；结果显示总体准确率提升有限，但时间压力下增益明显，且能更好复现人类棋力退化。
AI.relevance_reason: 用条件 token 把剩余时间/预算注入状态表示，并对思考时长与认输建模，可能为 LVR 中「计算预算条件化」和 STOP 决策提供方法线索；但棋类行为克隆与视觉推理差距较大，其可迁移性需核查。
